disclaimer.label: Please note
disclaimer.hs: HS code suggestions are a starting point. Confirm the final code with your customs broker or the ITC-HS schedule before you file.
disclaimer.trust: These checks use public and licensed sources and can be out of date. They reduce risk but cannot rule it out. Use secure payment terms for new buyers.
disclaimer.sanctions: Sanctions screening compares names against published lists. A clear result is not legal advice; check again before you sign a contract or ship.
disclaimer.coverage: Coverage labels show how much buyer data we hold for a country and product. Some real buyers may be missing from the list.
